Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Operational logs and hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next actions are the consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix; no new tracking or outreach.

Continue containment-only execution. Existing deferred SEO, performance, accessibility, information-architecture, conversion, and attribution opportunities are not legal launch approvals. Do not create proposals, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, requeues, deployments, monetization changes, spend, external outreach, or unsupported revenue claims.
